description: Defines classes, structs, and interfaces for managing RRC Dual-Connectivity (DU) components, including cell info, UE management, connection events, and metrics collection within the ocudu::ocucp namespace.

classes.name: rrc_cell_info
classes.description: Holds information about a cell, including band, PCI, measurement timings, timers, and PLMN identities.

classes.name: rrc_du_cell_manager
classes.description: Interface for managing cell information within the RRC DU.

classes.name: rrc_resume_context_t
classes.description: Contains context information for RRC resume procedures, including resume ID and cause.

classes.name: rrc_ue_creation_message
classes.description: Data structure for creating a new RRC UE, including identifiers, context, and notifiers.

classes.name: rrc_du_ue_repository
classes.description: Interface for managing RRC UEs, including adding, removing, and retrieving UEs.

classes.name: rrc_ue_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling RRC UE removal and lookup.

classes.name: rrc_du_connection_event_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling connection-related events and metrics updates.

classes.name: rrc_du_metrics_collector
classes.description: Interface for collecting metrics from the RRC DU.

classes.name: rrc_du
classes.description: Main interface class combining cell management, UE management, event handling, and metrics collection.

methods.name: get_cell_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about served cells based on a list received from the DU.

methods.name: get_ran_area_cells
methods.description: Returns a list of RAN area cells.

methods.name: store_cell_info_db
methods.description: Stores cell information into a database.

methods.name: get_rrc_reject
methods.description: Returns the RRC reject message to send to a UE.

methods.name: get_rrc_resume_context
methods.description: Extracts RRC resume context from a container.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Creates and adds a new RRC UE object.

methods.name: release_ues
methods.description: Releases all UEs connected to the DU.

methods.name: get_nof_ues
methods.description: Returns the number of registered UEs.

methods.name: find_ue
methods.description: Finds a UE by its index.

methods.name: remove_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE by its index.

methods.name: handle_successful_rrc_setup
methods.description: Handles metrics update for successful RRC setup.

methods.name: handle_successful_rrc_release
methods.description: Handles metrics update for RRC release.

methods.name: handle_rrc_inactive
methods.description: Handles RRC inactive transition metrics.

methods.name: handle_attempted_rrc_setup
methods.description: Handles metrics for attempted RRC setup.

methods.name: handle_attempted_rrc_reestablishment
methods.description: Handles metrics for attempted RRC re-establishment.

methods.name: handle_successful_rrc_reestablishment
methods.description: Handles metrics for successful RRC re-establishment.

methods.name: handle_successful_rrc_reestablishment_fallback
methods.description: Handles fallback metrics for RRC re-establishment.

methods.name: handle_attempted_rrc_resume
methods.description: Handles metrics for attempted RRC resume.

methods.name: handle_successful_rrc_resume
methods.description: Handles metrics for successful RRC resume.

methods.name: handle_successful_rrc_resume_with_fallback
methods.description: Handles fallback metrics for RRC resume.

methods.name: handle_rrc_resume_followed_by_network_release
methods.description: Handles metrics for RRC resume followed by network release.

methods.name: handle_attempted_rrc_resume_followed_by_rrc_setup
methods.description: Handles metrics for RRC resume followed by RRC setup.

methods.name: collect_metrics
methods.description: Collects metrics from the RRC DU.

methods.name: get_rrc_du_cell_manager
methods.description: Returns reference to cell manager component.

methods.name: get_rrc_du_ue_repository
methods.description: Returns reference to UE repository component.

methods.name: get_rrc_ue_handler
methods.description: Returns reference to UE handler component.

methods.name: get_rrc_du_connection_event_handler
methods.description: Returns reference to connection event handler.

methods.name: get_rrc_du_metrics_collector
methods.description: Returns reference to metrics collector.
